summary: Implemented shacl_path_to_rdflib(graph, node) in rdflib/paths.py, converting a SHACL sh:path value into a URIRef or Path (InvPath, SequencePath, AlternativePath, MulPath), with ValueError for invalid input. Added tests to test/test_path.py. test/test_path.py plus the paths.py doctests pass (33 passed), and test/test_namespace and test/test_graph pass (438 passed, 11 xfailed). mypy was not run because it is not installed in the shared venv, and I did not install it. Nothing was committed.
